name: How does project management support communication between designer, engineer, and contractor?

mainEntity.name: How does project management support communication between designer, engineer, and contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project manager facilitates coordination meetings, shares updated drawings and details, records decisions, and ensures that everyone is working from the same current information set.
